Why we're doing this

Our Story

— ✦ ❦ ✦ —

The Sparkle of Hope Ball is being held in aid of St Margaret of Scotland Hospice in Clydebank, a place that has come to mean so much to one of our committee members and her family.

Her dad is living with cancer and is currently being cared for by the Hospice. Experiencing their care first-hand has shown her family the compassion, dignity and kindness given not only to patients, but to the people who love them.

While her dad's experience was the inspiration behind the ball, The Sparkle of Hope Ball is for everyone. It is for every patient cared for by the Hospice, past and present; for families who have sat beside someone they love; for those who have lost loved ones; and for those currently being supported.

Together, as a committee, we want to turn that gratitude into something positive and raise as much as we can to support the incredible care the Hospice provides.

Every donation, every act of support, every sparkle makes a difference.
